outcome: Each agent role has explicit capability limits, and push, pull request, and production CI stay blocked until a human approval is granted
acceptance: each role stores allowed work-item types, tools, write permissions, approval requirements, and forbidden actions
read, draft, code change, commit, push, pull request, local CI, production CI, review approval, and merge are separate permissions
planner cannot push or open a pull request even with approval
generator push or pull request without approval is denied and audited
a granted approval from a different human allows generator push
the requester cannot approve their own request
evaluator can run local CI without approval
production CI without approval is denied and audited
developer progress shows capability boundaries before a task starts
inScope: gated local push and pull-request intent
assumptions: local Git inspect remains allowed without approval
lint and hygiene remain blocked probe scripts
